Method of Attack: Exploiting ProxyShell vulnerabilities in Microsoft Exchange servers to install web shells, drop Cobalt Strike beacon, dump credentials, install AnyDesk for lateral movement, privilege escalation, and ransomware deployment
Indicators of Compromise: Installation of web shells on Exchange servers
Dropping Cobalt Strike beacon injected into Windows Update Agent process
Deletion of shadow copies via WMI
Modification of registry values for privilege escalation and network sharing
Use of AnyDesk remote access tool
Exfiltration of stolen files using WinRAR and anonymous file-sharing platforms such as file.io and anonymfiles.com
